notes.title: Big update for the Stellar Wanderer DX demo!
notes.notes:
Dear explorers,

We are pleased to announce that the Stellar Wanderer DX demo has been updated to version 0.6! This update brings a slew of visual, sound, UX, and localization improvements to the demo.

Check the patch notes below:

- updated environments
- updated capital ships and installations
- updated fighter ships and cockpits
- updated space stations (interior and exterior)
- new jumpgate and dock animations
- new sounds and fxs for engines and weapons
- new explosions
- new localizations. The full list now includes German, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Japanese, Simplified/Traditional Chinese. This is still in a work in progress, some texts might still show up not translated.
- UI fixes
- many other under-the-hood fixes and improvements

Please don't hesitate to share with us your feedback and any issues you may encounter in the demo on the game's Community Hub page.

Stellar Wanderer DX team
